rules.title: Los Angeles RSO Annual Rent Increase Limit (July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026)
rules.quote: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.summary: For rental units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, the maximum annual rent increase from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
rules.coverage_text: rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.exemption_note: Coverage depends on whether unit is subject to RSO; document directs users to check zimas.lacity.org

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO Utility Pass-Through Prohibition
rules.quote: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.summary: Starting February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units cannot add any additional percentage increase to rent for utilities.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.coverage_text: rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
